sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

Each level features a different song, with the tiles moving faster and becoming more challenging to hit as you progress. The game also features obstacles, such as gold tiles that slow down time or red tiles that speed it up. To increase your score, you need to tap on the black tiles in time with the music, avoiding the obstacles and creating a perfect rhythm.

The game also features a variety of modes, including a normal mode, a challenge mode, and a mode where you can play with your friends.
